title: Legislative Council Building, Brunei
scope: The four-storey State Legislative Council Building on Jalan Dewan Majlis, including its two wings, central domed chamber and ceremonial entrance.
limitations: The mapped perimeter and covered drive are direct geographic controls. Unmeasured upper heights, dome radius, roof subdivisions and façade spacing are approximate.
The façade finishes and woven motifs are simplified from published descriptions. The scope is the public exterior, including the ceremonial entrance and standing council wings.
The image in the story depicts the original council members in 1959, before construction of the present building. This reconstruction uses written architectural records and mapped shape.
